gui_forms::RadioButton.summary: RadioButton specializes ButtonBase with retained checked state, container-scoped named exclusion groups, optional automatic checking, three indicator families, ordered events, and radio semantics.
remarks: Checked state is retained; a named group within the same logical container is exclusive, so checking one radio button unchecks its group peers.
`auto_check` controls automatic checking on activation; `checked_changed` follows the mutation.
gui_forms::RadioButton.ownership: Created by the application as a `Control::Ptr` (`std::shared_ptr<Control>`). A parent holds its children strongly and a child holds its parent weakly; cycles, duplicate stable IDs, cross-window reparenting, and disposed children are rejected. Disposal through `Component::dispose()` is synchronous and idempotent and revokes owned subscriptions before subclass teardown.
gui_forms::RadioButton.threading: UI-thread affine. Read and mutate on the owning Window's UI thread; wrong-thread mutation is rejected by the Window access guards (`Window::check_access` and `Window::verify_access`). The type is not internally synchronized.
gui_forms::RadioButton.availability: Renderer-neutral core (`gui_forms_controls`). Available wherever the GUI.Forms core builds: the macOS AppKit host, the Windows Win32 host, and the opt-in Linux X11 host. The public API is not yet stable.
